description:
DNSEndpoint is a contract that a user-specified CRD must implement to be used as a source for external-dns.
The user-specified CRD should also have the status sub-resource.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: DNSEndpointSpec defines the desired state of DNSEndpoint

endpoints.description: Endpoints is the list of DNS records this resource declares.

items.description: Endpoint is a high-level way of a connection between a service and an IP

dnsName.description:
DNSName is the hostname of the DNS record. It is at most 253 characters, or 254
written as an absolute name with a trailing dot.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: dnsName must be at most 253 characters, or 254 including the trailing dot

labels.description: Labels stores labels defined for the Endpoint

items.description: ProviderSpecificProperty holds the name and value of a configuration which is specific to individual DNS providers

name.description:
Name of the provider-specific property. Accepted names are provider
dependent; see the tutorial for the provider in use.

recordTTL.description:
RecordTTL is the TTL of the record in seconds. 0 means "not set" and lets
the provider apply its own default. The upper bound is the RFC 2181 §8 maximum.

recordType.description: RecordType is the DNS record type.

setIdentifier.description:
SetIdentifier distinguishes multiple records with the same name and type
(e.g. Route53 records with routing policies other than 'simple').

targets.description:
Targets are the values the DNS record points to. Leaving it empty is only
meaningful when --default-targets is configured.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: SRV targets must be '<priority> <weight> <port> <host>' with an absolute host, e.g. '10 5 5060 sip.example.com.'
NAPTR targets must be absolute and end with a dot
PTR dnsName must be a reverse DNS name under .in-addr.arpa or .ip6.arpa, written without a trailing dot, e.g. '1.0.0.10.in-addr.arpa'

status.description: DNSEndpointStatus defines the observed state of DNSEndpoint

observedGeneration.description: The generation observed by the external-dns controller.
